Internal helper: the entries of a NEWS.md between two versions

Source: R/utils.R
dot-jst_news_entries.Rd

An entry is a level-one heading naming the package and a version – "# jstats 0.9.252", a "v" before the number or anything after it allowed – and the lines under it up to the next level-one heading. A level-one heading with no version ("# jstats (development version)") is no entry. Kept: the entries newer than from and no newer than to, newest first whatever the file's order.

Usage

.jst_news_entries(lines, from, to)

Arguments

lines

Character vector: the file's lines.

from, to

Version strings.

Value

A list of entries, each a list with version, title (the heading as text) and body (its lines).
